planets.name: TOI-2084 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2084 with a 6.08-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-2084 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2084. Its orbit and size follow Barkaoui et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
